Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Bidder to quote with Bid specific authorization directly from OEM otherwise offer will be summarily rejec ted without any back reference and no representation will be entertained. 2. Firm shall attach catalogue of offered product along with offer for technical scrutiny with clear mention o f make and model. 3. For past performance firm should attach proof of supply signed by either purchaser, consigner, inspect or nominated by purchaser (should not be firm representative). For this purpose receipt note, inspection c ertificate, CRAC, receipted challan, work completion certificate etc. should be attached with bid. Proof of s upply should clearly indicate quantity supplied and date of supply. Only copy of purchase order, self signe d tax invoice, self made performance statement will not establish that supply has been completed. Perfor mance of GeM bid category “Surveillance Drone / Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (V2)" shall only be considered. 4. Firm must upload the certificate, mentioning the percentage of local content in the material being offere d. Please enter 0 for fully imported items, and 100 for fully indigenous items. The definition and calculation of local content shall be in accordance with the Make in India policy. The firm has to certify that the item o ffered meets the minimum local content and shall give details of the locations at which the local value add ition is made. 5. Inspection: By RITES. 6.Warranty – 30 months.

7. If firm don't upload any requisite certificate along with bid, their offer will be summarily rejected. 8. No new document will be accepted after opening of bid through any channel. If firm do not submit perfo rmance document along with bid then offer will be summarily rejected and in representation no new docu ment will be accepted. If any conflict was found with other bid condition mentioned anywhere in bid document then above eight c onditions will prevail. .
